newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE robusta coffee drift lower, switches dominat.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE robusta coffee drift lower, switches dominat.

text.p: LIFFE robusta coffee futures shed slim gains to stay slightly lower in slow, switch-dominated Wednesday morning trade.
However most positions were off their lows by the morning close helped by bargain-hunters.
Volume reached 2,914 lots, with interest seen in the far forward months.
July was $7 lower at $1,648 a tonne after ranging $1,659 and $1,636 while May gave up $10 at $1,618.
In switches, May/July was traded $23-$30 and July/Sept at $9-12. There were also some trades in May/Nov spread.
Traders called New York's equivalent futures market to open unchanged to 0.5 cent up.
The U.S. arabica futures came under further profit-taking selling on Tuesday after the recent surge to new 2-1/2 year peaks.
The on-going Colombian truckers strike did little to deter sellers.
There were little signs so far that the worker action, which enters a fourth day on Wednesday, would come to an early resolution.
Some traders said the stoppage could wreak havoc to coffee shipments if it lasts more than 10 days.
Technically, London's July could face an uphill struggle to revisit the $1,700 level which it briefly tested on Monday.
But support is seen intact at $1,610 and $1,600.
